name: Quy Nhon
provinceNote: The tourism portal still prints this city in Bình Định.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Yellow sand fills the center of the city, and Xuân Diệu is the road behind it after dark. Stay when that night is the reason you came. Go to Da Nang, 300 km north, when that city is the trip. Road minutes are check on arrival. Do not treat Kỳ Co as this beach. It is nearly 25 km away.
timeNeeded: A night on the crescent, plus a day on Phuong Mai or the south coast
fee: No single city ticket. The city beach is free.
getThere: Phù Cát airport, or Diêu Trì on the north–south railway. Da Nang is 300 km by the coast road. Road minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Quy Nhon: stay for the crescent night on Xuan Dieu
seoDescription: Stay on the Quy Nhon crescent when Xuan Dieu at night is the trip. Da Nang is 300 km up the coast, and those road minutes are check on arrival.
intro: You wake on a long crescent of yellow sand the portal calls fairly clear and blue, with the buildings along Xuân Diệu a short walk from the water. Stay here when that night is the trip. Go to Da Nang, 300 km up the coast, when that city is the trip, or continue south toward Nha Trang. Road minutes on both are check on arrival.

The city beach is free. The portal’s open field is 6:00–23:00, and its visit field is 60 minutes. A beach day is longer than that field. A chair or an umbrella is check on arrival. The mistake is treating Kỳ Co as this sand. Kỳ Co is a separate cove, nearly 25 km away, and that page does not split the distance into road and boat.

Evening is Xuân Diệu, for seafood and a cafe on the sand, then Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành, 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name. The square is free and the open field is 6:00–22:00. Horse carts leave from Xuân Diệu near the square, along Xuân Diệu or An Dương Vương. The fare is check on arrival. The square names New Year fireworks and Festival võ Bình Định and does not print a month.

The second picture is Cầu Thị Nại. The bridge page calls it the longest sea bridge and does not print the metres. The lagoon page prints 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km that also has five shorter bridges. The photograph is the span by day. The portal describes the lamps after dark. The lagoon is 8 km northeast. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival. The printed 7:00–18:00 line is not a gate that closes the road.

A day across the bridge is Phương Mai. Eo Gió is the rock saddle: 25,000 đồng, children under 0.9 m free, open 7:00–19:00. One page calls the sunset the finest in Vietnam. A 24 Feb 2021 page on the same portal calls it the finest sunrise. The calm window on that page is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9, and it says to stay away when the sea is rough. Kỳ Co’s header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng. The prose does not say whether that is a gate, a boat, or a range. Read the board. Do not fold that range into Eo Gió’s 25,000 đồng.

South of the center, Ghềnh Ráng is about 3 km and free: egg-shaped stones, and the cove the portal names bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed there. Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road. Its fee is check on arrival. Inside the city, Tháp Đôi is the late-12th-century Cham pair, 20,000 đồng, 7:00–18:00. The header says Phường Quy Nhơn. The prose says phường Đống Đa. Tháp Bánh Ít, about 20 km away, is a different site.
gettingAround: The city beach is a walk from the center. Sleep on the crescent if that night is the trip. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter sand. Lodging there runs from homestay to resort as types. No brand is a pick.

Phù Cát is the airport. The portal says a flight to Hồ Chí Minh City takes 1 hour and a flight to Hà Nội takes 2 hours. It does not print the airport code, the kilometres to the beach, or a transfer fare. A Đà Nẵng flight is not named. Kilometres and the city transfer are check on arrival.

Ga Diêu Trì is the stop on the unified north–south table. Ga Quy Nhơn is not a row on that table. The table’s HTML still says “gio tau 2014”, and the header has no revision date, so the clocks below are the cells on the page, not a confirmed 2026 reprint. Southbound SE7 cells are Đà Nẵng 22:30 and Diêu Trì 04:12 the next day. Northbound SE8 cells are Sài Gòn 06:00 and Diêu Trì 18:07. Fares are check on arrival. Extra trains SE30 and SE29 stopped at both Diêu Trì and Quy Nhơn in February and March 2025 only. Those dates are past.

The portal prints 300 km to Đà Nẵng, 686 km to Hồ Chí Minh City, and 1,065 km from Hà Nội. Road minutes are check on arrival. A motorbike fare and a taxi fare from Diêu Trì or Phù Cát are check on arrival. Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km, and the page does not split road time from boat time. Hải Minh is about 15 minutes by boat from bến Hàm Tử. That boat fare is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: The crescent
stayAreas.summary: Beachfront rooms along the yellow sand, a walk from the swim and from Xuân Diệu after dark. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter alternative. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: Order bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ. The 2019 newspaper piece says the broth is simmered from fish bones, often tuna or sailfish, and the cakes are both fried and steamed. Dip the cake in chili sauce and pickled shallot, and put the herbs in the bowl.

Bánh xèo tôm nhảy rau mầm is the thin yellow cake with small freshwater shrimp that turn red, bean sprouts, and scallion. Wrap it with sprouts, cucumber, and star fruit, and eat it with fish sauce. The night piece places it on Diên Hồng and Đống Đa, and says the menu also includes squid, beef, and egg. A shop hour was not printed.

The same 2019 piece describes bún nem as noodles with nem chua, grilled fish cake, herbs, peanut, pickled mustard, and coriander, in a sour-hot-salty-sweet sauce that changes by shop. It places the bowl in the center and does not name a street. Bánh mì lagu is a thick soup with a large piece of pork, eaten with bread, from a lane off Nguyễn Huệ. That shop is not a pick.

The portal names bánh hỏi lòng heo, bánh ít lá gai, bún Song Thằn, nem chợ huyện, bánh tráng nước dừa, and bánh bèo, and it does not describe those plates. How to eat them is check on arrival. No stall price is printed here.
interestsBody: The city crescent is the swim in the center. Kỳ Co is not that beach.
Phương Mai is the day across Thị Nại: Eo Gió’s rock saddle and Kỳ Co’s closed cove. The sunset line and the sunrise line both stay.
Tháp Đôi is the Cham pair inside the city. The museum on Nguyễn Huệ keeps the Cham room: five rooms, free, open 7:00–17:00.
The bridge page describes the white span and the lamps after dark. This frame is the span by day.
Ghềnh Ráng is the egg-stone cove south of the center. Bãi Xếp is 13 km on, and its fee is check on arrival.
The night market is the 2019 page that names clothes, shoes, and souvenirs. The street is check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The city crescent
interestGroups.summary: The yellow sand in the center, a walk from the rooms, not Kỳ Co.
body: The portal calls Bãi biển Quy Nhơn a long crescent of yellow sand with water that is fairly clear and blue. The header places it in Phường Quy Nhơn. The swim is free, and the open field is 6:00–23:00. A chair is check on arrival.
Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành is 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name, free, with an open field of 6:00–22:00. The crescent in the photograph is the beach by day.

cards.title: City beach
cards.summary: Swim the yellow crescent in the center. Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km away.

interestGroups.title: Phuong Mai for the day
interestGroups.summary: Eo Gió’s rock saddle and Kỳ Co’s closed crescent, the day across Thị Nại.
body: Eo Gió is a curved gap between two rock ridges. The fee is 25,000 đồng, and children under 0.9 m are free. The open field is 7:00–19:00. The page’s calm season is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough. Kilometres from the city beach are check on arrival.

The Eo Gió page says photographers have called the sunset the finest in Vietnam. A 24 Feb 2021 news page on the same portal calls it the finest sunrise. Kỳ Co’s header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng and does not say what the range buys. Read the board. The header says Phường Quy Nhơn Đông. The prose says xã Nhơn Lý.

cards.title: Eo Gio
cards.summary: Stand in the rock saddle and look down at the sea. The fee is 25,000 đồng.

cards.title: Ky Co
cards.summary: A crescent with hills on three sides, nearly 25 km out. Read the price board before you pay.

interestGroups.title: Twin towers and the Cham room
interestGroups.summary: Tháp Đôi inside the city, and the Cham room at the museum on Nguyễn Huệ.
body: Tháp Đôi, also Tháp Hưng Thạnh, is a pair of late-12th-century Cham towers: a square body and a curved top, Garuda at the corners, ranked an architecture-and-art relic in 1980. The fee is 20,000 đồng. The open field is 7:00–18:00. The visit field is 120 minutes, which is the field printed, not a timed walk. The header says Phường Quy Nhơn. The prose says phường Đống Đa.

Bảo tàng tổng hợp Bình Định is at 26 Nguyễn Huệ. It is free, open 7:00–17:00, and holds five rooms, including a Cham room, plus sculpture in the yard. Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away and is not this visit.

cards.title: Twin towers
cards.summary: Both Cham towers, inside the city. The fee is 20,000 đồng.

interestGroups.title: The bridge after dark
interestGroups.summary: The white span across the lagoon. This frame is the bridge by day.
body: The bridge page describes afternoon light and the lamps after dark, and it uses the longest-bridge claim without metres. The lagoon page prints 2,477.3 m, 54 spans, and a road of more than 7 km. Crossing is free. The 7:00–18:00 field is not a gate that closes the road. The lagoon is 8 km northeast. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.
The photograph is the full span by day, with mangrove and water. The lamps are the portal’s description of the bridge after dark.

cards.title: Thi Nai bridge
cards.summary: The span by day. The portal’s night is the lamps.

interestGroups.title: Queen’s cove
interestGroups.summary: Ghềnh Ráng’s egg stones, about 3 km southeast of the center.
body: The portal names egg-shaped stones the sea has rounded, and calls the cove bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed here. It also names a Vọng Phu rock, a lion-shaped rock, bãi tắm Tiên Sa, and Hàn Mặc Tử’s grave on the hillside. It says Bảo Đại chose Ghềnh Ráng as a royal retreat from 1927. The visit is free. The open field is 7:00–18:00. The church page puts the area about 3 km southeast.
Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on quốc lộ 1D. The 2021 article splits it into two crescent beaches in a fishing village. Its fee is check on arrival.

cards.title: Ghenh Rang
cards.summary: Walk the egg stones and the cove the portal names for Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu.

interestGroups.title: Night market stalls
interestGroups.summary: Clothes, shoes, and souvenirs. The street is check on arrival.
body: The 2019 tourism piece says Chợ Đêm sells clothes, shoes, and souvenirs. It does not give the street. Do not invent one. Hours and a stall price are check on arrival.

cards.title: Night market
cards.summary: Stalls of clothes and souvenirs. The street on the 2019 page is still check on arrival.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Quy Nhon or Da Nang?
faqs.a: Stay here when the night on the crescent and Xuân Diệu is the trip. Go to Da Nang when that city is the trip. The portal prints 300 km between them. Road minutes are check on arrival. A flight from Phù Cát to Đà Nẵng is not named.

faqs.q: What do the Kỳ Co and Cù Lao Xanh price fields buy?
faqs.a: Kỳ Co’s header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng, and Cù Lao Xanh’s header prints 200,000–350,000 đồng. Neither page says whether the figure is a gate, a boat, or a range. Read the board. Do not treat either figure as Eo Gió’s 25,000 đồng ticket.

faqs.q: Is the city still Quy Nhon?
faqs.a: The tourism portal still describes Bình Định, with Quy Nhơn as its center, and prints 6,039.56 km² and 1,500,000 people. A 22 Apr 2025 draft described a merged province named Gia Lai, with the administrative center at present-day Quy Nhơn, about 21,576 km² and more than 3.1 million people. Those figures are not the portal’s. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 is dated 12 June 2025. Its clause text did not load, so a capital, an area, and a population are not taken from it.

faqs.q: When is the Nước Mặn festival?
faqs.a: A 27 Feb 2025 article says that year’s public days were 27 Feb–1 Mar 2025, lunar 30th of the first month through the 2nd of the second month, Ất Tỵ. It says “this year.” The next solar date is check on arrival. The place is thôn An Hòa, xã Phước Quang, huyện Tuy Phước, not the city beach. The article calls the festival national intangible heritage, recognized in 2022.

Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. The Quang Trung museum is about 45 km northwest, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. Minutes for both are check on arrival. Trung Lương’s header says free and the body on the same page says 40,000 đồng including a shower, children under 1 m free. Xuân Diệu’s childhood house is at Gò Bồi, not the beach street. Its fee and hours are check on arrival. Quảng Ngãi and Sông Cầu are the coast on either side. Hầm Hô’s fee, hours, and kilometres are check on arrival.

season.label: Check on arrival
season.note: The portal’s climate line is an average of 27.4°C and 1,935 mm of rain, not a month-by-month calendar. Eo Gió’s page says the calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9, and to stay away when the sea is rough. A solar best-month table for the city beach was not on these pages.
